slides.title: Two garden beds
slides.text: Tally planted two garden beds. Which bed has more?

slides.title: Match them one to one
slides.text: Line them up, one to one. The row with extras has more.

visual.label: 5 apples over 3 lemons, matched one to one

focus.cue: Three apples have a lemon partner.
Two apples have no partner. There are more apples.

slides.title: Fewer means not as many
slides.text: The pears run out first. There are fewer pears than plums.

visual.label: 4 pears over 6 plums, matched one to one

focus.cue: The pear row is shorter: 4 pears.

slides.title: The same number
slides.text: Every apple has a partner. The beds have the same number.

visual.label: 4 apples over 4 lemons, every one matched

focus.cue: Four pairs and no extras: the same.

slides.title: Which number is more?
slides.text: Count up to compare two numbers. The number you say later is more.

visual.label: A number line from 0 to 10 with 4 and 6 marked

words.means: just as many, with no extras

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Garden Count at More or Fewer. Pick more, fewer or the same six times.
slides.alt: Garden Count on a phone: a row of apples over a row of lemons, and a big button for each row.
